description: This file defines a BookingPayloadBuilder class for constructing webhook payloads related to booking events, specifically for the versioned webhook format v2021-10-20. It includes methods for normalizing responses, deriving name parts, and building payloads for various booking trigger events such as creation, cancellation, rescheduling, and payment updates.

classes.name: BookingPayloadBuilder
classes.description: A class extending BaseBookingPayloadBuilder that constructs webhook payloads for booking events, handling different trigger types and payload formatting.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the appropriate webhook payload based on the trigger event in the DTO.

methods.name: buildBookingPayload
methods.description: Creates the standard booking payload structure for a specific trigger event, including attendee and organizer data.

methods.name: normalizeResponses
methods.description: Normalizes response labels to default labels if they match certain criteria.

methods.name: nameToFirstAndLast
methods.description: Splits a full name string into first and last name components.
